_comment: A pinned, unmodified copy of two Learn pages' source, 'Configure an app to trust an external identity provider' and 'Configure a user-assigned managed identity to trust an external identity provider', with the include both pages share for the federated credential rules: the az CLI, Azure PowerShell, az rest, REST and ARM template samples for federated identity credentials exist only inside these pages. Never edit these files: update the snapshot by copying a newer upstream commit and regenerating this manifest in a reviewed pull request. scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py fails when a file stops matching its hash.
name: Learn samples: federated identity credentials on an app registration and on a user-assigned managed identity
files_last_changed: 2026-02-25 (commit d75a90ea1b07d0d2007cfab256c1ad02653d1e35, the last commit to all three files); unchanged at the repository's head on 2026-10-30 (commit 7f78b50dce9d8cf119de57cbd6fd66e24a6c58d4)

not_copied: The pages' screenshots (docs/workload-id/media) and the reusable Azure CLI include (docs/reusable-content/azure-cli/azure-cli-prepare-your-environment-no-header.md), which hold no sample.

The considerations page (workload-identity-federation-considerations.md) and the flexible federated credential pages, which the chapter cites and links rather than runs; everything else in MicrosoftDocs/entra-docs.
